style_block: Warm cinematic 35mm film-grain photorealism, shot on period Kodak film stock, evoking an actual 1987 yacht rock album photo shoot rather than a modern lifestyle photo - the image must read unmistakably as the 1980s, not as a timeless or contemporary coastal scene. Golden-hour and sunset lighting, soft warm lens flare, visible film grain and halation around bright highlights, warm saturated amber-teal-coral color grading typical of 1980s film photography, soft focus falloff at the frame edges. Explicit period-accurate details required in every scene: boxy 1980s convertible sports cars (Mercedes-Benz R107 SL or Porsche 911 Cabriolet silhouettes), pastel Art-Deco-revival Miami-style resort architecture with rounded corners and neon trim, wood-paneled sailboats and classic fiberglass motor yachts of the era, analog dock hardware, a portable cassette boombox or a chunky corded marina phone visible where a prop is needed, period-correct signage with 1980s typography and pastel color blocking. Coastal Southern California / Florida yacht-club setting - marinas, sailboats, palm-lined boardwalks, pier restaurants, beach houses with wraparound decks. Cinematic 16:9 composition, relaxed and romantic mood. All people depicted are archetypal, fictionalized, stylized figures representative of the era rather than an exact reproduction or likeness of any real actor or real named individual. No modern cars, no modern architecture, no modern signage or typography, no modern technology, no smartphones, no flat screen displays, no exact photographic likeness of any real person, no watermark, no signature, no extra fingers, no distorted limbs, no text anywhere in the image.

characters.WOMAN: an archetypal 1980s woman in her late twenties, stylized and fictionalized rather than an exact likeness of any real person, big soft-curled and feathered sun-streaked blonde hair in a 1980s volume style, large white or tortoiseshell oversized sunglasses, a shoulder-padded blouse or a bright pastel coral off-the-shoulder dress with a high waist, layered chunky gold jewelry including large gold hoop earrings, a warm relaxed smile, sun-kissed skin
characters.MAN: an archetypal 1980s man in his early thirties, stylized and fictionalized rather than an exact likeness of any real person, short neat dark hair with a slight feathered 1980s cut, aviator sunglasses pushed up or worn, a pastel or white linen blazer with the sleeves pushed up over a bright polo shirt with the collar popped, a thin gold chain necklace, white deck trousers, deck shoes, an easygoing confident bearing
characters.CAR: a boxy 1980s convertible sports car with chrome trim and period-correct round headlights, top down, in a cream or pastel color
